content.title: 50 Free Promotional Housing Units
summary: A 50-home R+13 residential delivery in Sidi Benour, part of a wider 362-home free promotional housing programme.
The Sidi Benour scheme addresses urban residential demand through vertical massing, integrated utility networks, and coordinated site circulation.
description: The project scope encompasses all-trades delivery (TCE) and roads and utility networks (VRD) for the R+13 residential block, coordinating structural execution, facade articulation, building services, and external works.
The facade articulation is defined by vertical lines and projecting balconies, supported by comprehensive site grading, utility connections, and dedicated access roads.
content.authority: A high-rise residential development where structural engineering, facade rhythm, VRD, and technical systems are integrated to meet dense urban housing requirements.

faq.question: What is the scope of the 50 Free Promotional Housing Units project?
faq.answer: A 50-home R+13 residential delivery in Sidi Benour, part of a wider 362-home free promotional housing programme.

faq.question: What construction works were executed on this site?
faq.answer: The project combines TCE and VRD delivery for a R+13 residential building, coordinating structure, facades, technical systems and exterior circulation.

faq.question: How does the development integrate with the surrounding site?
faq.answer: The design utilizes vertical massing to optimize land use, supported by dedicated access roads and integrated utility connections to ensure full operational readiness.
